channel.title: Relay Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Relay on macOS.

item.description:
## Screenshot editor
- A compact floating bottom toolbar gives more space to the image, with discreet icons and tooltips. - Color and size controls stay together; the size menu switches between line thickness and text size for the selected tool or mark. - Copy & Close is beside Copy at the top right. It copies the annotated image, saves it to Desktop, and closes the editor. Failed export keeps the image open. - Copy and Save continue to leave the editor open.
The native macOS area selector, pixel-size readout and Space-drag from 0.3.15 remain included. This update focuses on the editor layout; further capture-smoothness improvements are still being investigated.

Faster, tighter screenshot capture:
- Uses macOS's native crosshair selector immediately, without taking full-display snapshots first or adding Relay's screen dimming. - Native size readout and Space-drag to reposition the selection; Escape cancels. - Smaller editor padding and toolbar, with the window sized around the capture. - Improved text focus, repeated text entry, and placement near image edges. - Reuses the captured image while drawing annotations. - Closing still saves the annotated PNG to Desktop and copies it to the clipboard.

A roomier screenshot editor:
- Larger markup tools, clearer selection, and separate style and undo controls. - The toolbar adapts to smaller windows and follows light or dark appearance. - Closing a screenshot saves the final annotated PNG to your Desktop and copies it to the clipboard. - Existing screenshots are never overwritten. If saving fails, the editor stays open so you can retry.
